items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Then I went to work with, or I went to work with the Buzzy and Charlie at the Cadillac, I stayed all the time with them

ctx.x: George S. Peterson was a virtue, he was born about 1875. George S. Peterson was a virtuous of the percussion. He played at the Tulane Theater for about 35 years. Also timpanish at the Sanger Theater.

Dick Denner went to work out at a place called the Peking Inn out in Bucktown. It was Chinese food, you know. Well out in Bucktown, you know, the big thing that people went out there for was to play the slot machines, you know, and dance and of course, Sproonings was more or less a fine rest, a family type of restaurant, Sproonings was, and of course people used to come out there to dance, you know what I mean, and play the slot machines and that's what they had all out there in Bucktown was slot machines, a lot…
